QUALITY vs CONTEXT
  CONTEXT     PROMPTS   REJECTED   REPEATED    TURNS
  <200k             3      33.3%      33.3%      2.0

  REPEATED is the agent re-issuing a call it already made, within its last
  50 — losing track of what it has done. Counted over a fixed lookback so a
  long session cannot inflate it. REJECTED is you saying the reply was wrong.
  Turns are shown for shape only: they fall as context grows because a
  low-context instruction is usually an early one, mid-orientation.

BIGGEST WIN
  The agent is redoing its own edits
  20.0% of edits revisit a file already edited answering the same instruction, across 5 edits
